en.text: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大支派按着宗族拈阄所得之地是在尽南边，到以东的交界，向南直到寻的旷野。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大支派按着宗族拈鬮所得之地是在儘南邊，到以東的交界，向南直到尋的曠野。

en.text: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

zhSimplified.text: 他们的南界是从盐海的尽边，就是从朝南的海汊起，

zhTraditional.text: 他們的南界是從鹽海的儘邊，就是從朝南的海汊起，

en.text: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

zhSimplified.text: 通到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，上到加低斯·巴尼亚的南边，又过希斯 ，上到亚达珥，绕到甲加，

zhTraditional.text: 通到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，上到加低斯‧巴尼亞的南邊，又過希斯崙，上到亞達珥，繞到甲加，

en.text: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

zhSimplified.text: 接连到押们，通到埃及小河，直通到海为止。这就是他们的南界。

zhTraditional.text: 接連到押們，通到埃及小河，直通到海為止。這就是他們的南界。

en.text: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

zhSimplified.text: 东界是从盐海南边到约旦河口。北界是从约旦河口的海汊起，

zhTraditional.text: 東界是從鹽海南邊到約旦河口。北界是從約旦河口的海汊起，

en.text: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

zhSimplified.text: 上到伯·曷拉，过伯·亚拉巴的北边，上到吕便之子波罕的磐石；

zhTraditional.text: 上到伯‧曷拉，過伯‧亞拉巴的北邊，上到呂便之子波罕的磐石；

en.text: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

zhSimplified.text: 从亚割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亚都冥坡对面的吉甲；又接连到隐·示麦泉，直通到隐·罗结，

zhTraditional.text: 從亞割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亞都冥坡對面的吉甲；又接連到隱‧示麥泉，直通到隱‧羅結，

en.text: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

zhSimplified.text: 上到欣嫩子谷，贴近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音谷极北的边界；

zhTraditional.text: 上到欣嫩子谷，貼近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西邊的山頂，就是在利乏音谷極北的邊界；

en.text: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

zhSimplified.text: 又从山顶延到尼弗多亚的水源，通到以弗 山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列·耶琳）；

zhTraditional.text: 又從山頂延到尼弗多亞的水源，通到以弗崙山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列‧耶琳）；

en.text: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

zhSimplified.text: 又从巴拉往西绕到西珥山，接连到耶琳山的北边（耶琳就是基撒 ）；又下到伯·示麦过亭纳，

zhTraditional.text: 又從巴拉往西繞到西珥山，接連到耶琳山的北邊（耶琳就是基撒崙）；又下到伯‧示麥過亭納，

en.text: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 通到以革伦北边，延到施基 ，接连到巴拉山；又通到雅比聂，直通到海为止。

zhTraditional.text: 通到以革倫北邊，延到施基崙，接連到巴拉山；又通到雅比聶，直通到海為止。

en.text: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。这是犹大人按着宗族所得之地四围的交界。 （士1·11—15）

zhTraditional.text: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。這是猶大人按着宗族所得之地四圍的交界。 （士1‧11－15）

en.text: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，将犹大人中的一段地，就是基列·亚巴，分给耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖（基列·亚巴就是希伯 ）。

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞照耶和華所吩咐的，將猶大人中的一段地，就是基列‧亞巴，分給耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）。

en.text: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长，就是示筛、亚希幔、挞买；

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒就從那裏趕出亞衲族的三個族長，就是示篩、亞希幔、撻買；

en.text: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

zhSimplified.text: 又从那里上去，攻击底璧的居民。（这底璧从前名叫基列·西弗。）

zhTraditional.text: 又從那裏上去，攻擊底璧的居民。（這底璧從前名叫基列‧西弗。）

en.text: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列·西弗将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒說：「誰能攻打基列‧西弗將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。」

en.text: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。

en.text: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

zhSimplified.text: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田，押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」

zhTraditional.text: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向她父親求一塊田，押撒一下驢，迦勒問她說：「你要甚麼？」

en.text: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

zhSimplified.text: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」她父亲就把上泉下泉赐给她。

zhTraditional.text: 她說：「求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。」她父親就把上泉下泉賜給她。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 以下是犹大支派按着宗族所得的产业。

zhTraditional.text: 以下是猶大支派按着宗族所得的產業。

en.text: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

zhSimplified.text: 犹大支派尽南边的城邑，与以东交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、

zhTraditional.text: 猶大支派儘南邊的城邑，與以東交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、

en.text: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

zhSimplified.text: 基拿、底摩拿、亚大达、

zhTraditional.text: 基拿、底摩拿、亞大達、

en.text: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

zhSimplified.text: 基低斯、夏琐、以提楠、

zhTraditional.text: 基低斯、夏瑣、以提楠、

en.text: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

zhSimplified.text: 西弗、提链、比亚绿、

zhTraditional.text: 西弗、提鍊、比亞綠、

en.text: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

zhSimplified.text: 夏琐·哈大他、加略·希斯 （加略·希斯 就是夏琐）、

zhTraditional.text: 夏瑣‧哈大他、加略‧希斯崙（加略‧希斯崙就是夏瑣）、

en.text: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

zhSimplified.text: 亚曼、示玛、摩拉大、

zhTraditional.text: 亞曼、示瑪、摩拉大、

en.text: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

zhSimplified.text: 哈萨·迦大、黑实门、伯·帕列、

zhTraditional.text: 哈薩‧迦大、黑實門、伯‧帕列、

en.text: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

zhSimplified.text: 哈萨·书亚、别是巴、比斯约他、

zhTraditional.text: 哈薩‧書亞、別是巴、比斯約他、

en.text: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

zhSimplified.text: 巴拉、以因、以森、

zhTraditional.text: 巴拉、以因、以森、

en.text: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

zhSimplified.text: 伊勒多腊、基失、何珥玛、

zhTraditional.text: 伊勒多臘、基失、何珥瑪、

en.text: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

zhSimplified.text: 洗革拉、麦玛拿、三撒拿、

zhTraditional.text: 洗革拉、麥瑪拿、三撒拿、

en.text: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 利巴勿、实忻、亚因、临门，共二十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 利巴勿、實忻、亞因、臨門，共二十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

zhSimplified.text: 在高原有以实陶、琐拉、亚实拿、

zhTraditional.text: 在高原有以實陶、瑣拉、亞實拿、

en.text: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

zhSimplified.text: 撒挪亚、隐·干宁、他普亚、以楠、

zhTraditional.text: 撒挪亞、隱‧干寧、他普亞、以楠、

en.text: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

zhSimplified.text: 耶末、亚杜兰、梭哥、亚西加、

zhTraditional.text: 耶末、亞杜蘭、梭哥、亞西加、

en.text: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 沙拉音、亚底他音、基底拉、基底罗他音，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 沙拉音、亞底他音、基底拉、基底羅他音，共十四座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

zhSimplified.text: 又有洗楠、哈大沙、麦大·迦得、

zhTraditional.text: 又有洗楠、哈大沙、麥大‧迦得、

en.text: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

zhSimplified.text: 底连、米斯巴、约帖、

zhTraditional.text: 底連、米斯巴、約帖、

en.text: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

zhSimplified.text: 拉吉、波斯加、伊矶伦、

zhTraditional.text: 拉吉、波斯加、伊磯倫、

en.text: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

zhSimplified.text: 迦本、拉幔、基提利、

zhTraditional.text: 迦本、拉幔、基提利、

en.text: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 基低罗、伯·大衮、拿玛、玛基大，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 基低羅、伯‧大袞、拿瑪、瑪基大，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

zhSimplified.text: 又有立拿、以帖、亚珊、

zhTraditional.text: 又有立拿、以帖、亞珊、

en.text: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

zhSimplified.text: 益弗他、亚实拿、尼悉、

zhTraditional.text: 益弗他、亞實拿、尼悉、

en.text: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 基伊拉、亚革悉、玛利沙，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 基伊拉、亞革悉、瑪利沙，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

zhSimplified.text: 又有以革伦和属以革伦的镇市村庄；

zhTraditional.text: 又有以革倫和屬以革倫的鎮市村莊；

en.text: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 从以革伦直到海，一切靠近亚实突之地，并属其地的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 從以革倫直到海，一切靠近亞實突之地，並屬其地的村莊。

en.text: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

zhSimplified.text: 亚实突和属亚实突的镇市村庄；迦萨和属迦萨的镇市村庄；直到埃及小河，并大海和靠近大海之地。

zhTraditional.text: 亞實突和屬亞實突的鎮市村莊；迦薩和屬迦薩的鎮市村莊；直到埃及小河，並大海和靠近大海之地。

en.text: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

zhSimplified.text: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、

zhTraditional.text: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、

en.text: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

zhSimplified.text: 大拿、基列·萨拿（基列·萨拿就是底璧）、

zhTraditional.text: 大拿、基列‧薩拿（基列‧薩拿就是底璧）、

en.text: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

zhSimplified.text: 亚拿伯、以实提莫、亚念、

zhTraditional.text: 亞拿伯、以實提莫、亞念、

en.text: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 歌珊、何伦、基罗，共十一座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 歌珊、何倫、基羅，共十一座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

zhSimplified.text: 又有亚拉、度玛、以珊、

zhTraditional.text: 又有亞拉、度瑪、以珊、

en.text: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

zhSimplified.text: 雅农、伯·他普亚、亚非加、

zhTraditional.text: 雅農、伯‧他普亞、亞非加、

en.text: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 宏他、基列·亚巴（基列·亚巴就是希伯 ）、洗珥，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 宏他、基列‧亞巴（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）、洗珥，共九座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

zhSimplified.text: 又有玛云、迦密、西弗、淤他、

zhTraditional.text: 又有瑪雲、迦密、西弗、淤他、

en.text: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

zhSimplified.text: 耶斯列、约甸、撒挪亚、

zhTraditional.text: 耶斯列、約甸、撒挪亞、

en.text: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 该隐、基比亚、亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 該隱、基比亞、亭納，共十座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

zhSimplified.text: 又有哈忽、伯·夙、基突、

zhTraditional.text: 又有哈忽、伯‧夙、基突、

en.text: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 玛腊、伯·亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪臘、伯‧亞諾、伊勒提君，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 又有基列·巴力（基列·巴力就是基列·耶琳）、拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 又有基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）、拉巴，共兩座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

zhSimplified.text: 在旷野有伯·亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、

zhTraditional.text: 在曠野有伯‧亞拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、

en.text: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 匿珊、盐城、隐·基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 匿珊、鹽城、隱‧基底，共六座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。

zhTraditional.text: 至於住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，猶大人不能把他們趕出去，耶布斯人卻在耶路撒冷與猶大人同住，直到今日。
